text: ②じょうげで　つかいたい　たいせつなもの　を　えらびます。

structure.jp: つかいたい　たいせつなもの　を
structure.en: the Key Item you want to use

patterns.name: 〜で (how)
patterns.explanation: で after a thing says you use it to do the action. じょうげで = 'with Up and Down'.

patterns.name: 〜たい
patterns.explanation: たい on the end of a verb says you want to do it. つかいたい = 'want to use'.

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: つかいたい　たいせつなもの
patterns.explanation: A verb put right before a thing tells you which thing. つかいたい　たいせつなもの = 'the Key Item you want to use'.
